title: Gloss Damage Indicators Document
description: Controls damage and healing number formatting, ballistic motion, presentation, admission, and world filtering. The document lives at plugins/Gloss/damage-indicators/default.json and hot reloads.

schemaVersion.description: Document format version. Must be exactly 1.

limits.description: Global admission, lifetime, delta, and numeric formatting limits.

filters.description: Worlds where neither damage nor healing indicators render.

lifetimeMs.description: Lifetime of each indicator in milliseconds.

minimumDelta.description: Applied health changes at or below this amount are ignored.

decimals.description: Decimal places rendered in the amount token.

format.description: Complete Gloss text template. Must contain {amount}.

offset.description: Spawn offset from the affected entity as [x, y, z].

motion.description: Cadence-independent ballistic motion in blocks and seconds.

presentation.description: Uniform scale animation and final-life fade.

horizontalSpeed.description: Horizontal speed in a random fixed direction, in blocks per second.

verticalSpeed.description: Initial vertical speed in blocks per second.

verticalAcceleration.description: Vertical acceleration in blocks per second squared.

spinDegreesPerSecond.description: Text-plane rotation speed in degrees per second.

fadeStartFraction.description: Lifetime fraction where opacity begins fading linearly to zero.

disabledWorlds.description: Exact world folder names where indicators are disabled.
